bullets.text: Chief Minister Vijay received a letter from Anbumani urging the notification and protection of the Pallikaranai marshland as a flood barrier.
Two 10th-grade students from Ambattur named Akhilram and Tharun Akash drowned while bathing in the Puzhal lake.
Heavy rains in Thiruvallur caused rainwater to surround residential areas near Athipattu, requiring monitoring by the office.
An unspecified minister gave updates from the spot in Velachery regarding red alerts and National Disaster Response Force readiness.
Minister Dr. Kumar.R initiated precautionary measures in Velachery as the northeast monsoon commenced.
Motorists faced difficulties on Velachery Main Road near the TNPDCL substation because a portion dug up for high-tension cables remained unrepaired.
The Tamil Nadu government issued a tender to prepare a report for restoring the Buckingham Canal, Cooum, and Adyar rivers.
Seeman urged the abandonment of the proposed clinker grinding plant in Thiruttani Karthikeyapuram due to environmental concerns.
The cybercrime wing of Avadi city police arrested a Delhi man for a boss scam involving 1.90 crore rupees transferred from an Ambattur company.
